title: Well data decoding tests the wrong decimal for token one
rootCause: Stable2.decodeWellData tests decimal0 a second time where it should test decimal1. decimal0 has already been given a value by then, so the branch never runs and a zero for token one stays zero, which every scaling that follows then uses.

poc.observable: test_token_one_decimals_are_read_from_their_own_value fails with "a zero for token one means 18: 0 != 18"
